title: A finite product of w-contractible rings is w-contractible.
statement: For every finite type I, including the empty type, and every family of commutative w-contractible rings D_i, the dependent product ring (i : I) -> D_i is w-contractible, in the sense of det-pe-wlocal-strict-contractible.

proof.text: Use Mathlib PrimeSpectrum.sigmaToPiHomeo to identify the spectrum of the finite product with the disjoint union of the factor spectra. A singleton in a summand is closed exactly when it is closed in the union. The continuous index projection to the discrete index type forces specializations to stay in a summand, so uniqueness of closed specializations and closedness of the closed-point set hold piecewise. Transport this w-local structure along the homeomorphism. Every maximal prime of the product comes from a factor, and its factor prime is maximal by surjectivity of the evaluation ring homomorphism. Mathlib Localization.AtPrime.mapPiEvalRingHom_bijective identifies its localization with that of the factor; transport strict henselianity using IsStrictlyHenselianLocalRing.of_ringEquiv. Finally the disjoint union of the closed-point spaces is homeomorphic to the closed-point space of the disjoint union. WLocalSpace.closedPointsHomeomorph identifies each closed-point space with the corresponding connected-component space, so extremal disconnectedness follows from the sigma-space instance and homeomorphism invariance. All steps also apply when the index type is empty.
